The '''Spire''' was a secret [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[prison]] located on the [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] [[planet]] [[Stygeon/Legends|Stygeon]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] held his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. [[Escape from the Spire/Legends|escaped]] with the help of [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1" />
